paper.title_en: Construction X4 for Quantum Stabilizer Codes
paper.abstract_en: Construction X has been well studied and widely used to construct quantum error-correcting codes from classical error-correcting codes. In this paper, we investigate Construction X4, a generalization of Construction X, to construct quantum error-correcting codes from arbitrary linear codes over a finite field of square order. We prove lower bounds on the minimum distance of the resulting quantum codes. For the special case where the classical codes are Hermitian self-orthogonal, we additionally present two new constructions of quantum codes. Furthermore, as an application, we explore quantum error-correcting codes derived from cyclic codes, Reed-Solomon codes, and generalized Reed-Solomon codes. We report numerous optimal and record-breaking quantum codes identified via our theorems.
